snippet.title: Chunky JUMP! × Among Us - Trailer
snippet.description:
😺WISHLIST CHUNKY JUMP! ON STEAM😺
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606780/Chunky_JUMP/

The third Chunky JUMP! crossover has been revealed! Among Us officially joins Chunky JUMP! Play as the Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, Cyan, Purple, Black and Pink crewmates in this brand-new Among Us-insipired levels. This crossover also includes a new minigame, Impostor's Hunt! Become the Impostor and kill all of your crewmates before time runs out, don't get caught or you'll get kicked out of the ship. Big thanks to the folks at Innersloth for letting us do this!

The Endless Mode roster just keeps growing and growing! But there's still a couple left, I wonder who will be Chunky and Vicky's next rivals?

❔What is Chunky JUMP?

A new short horror adventure in the world of The Bunny Graveyard. Perfect for new and returning players! Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

#indiegames #chunkyjump #amongus #pixelart #indiehorror #crossover
